interfaces.name: Suit
interfaces.signature: enum Suit: String, Codable, CaseIterable, Hashable, Sendable { case clubs, diamonds, hearts, spades; var color: CardColor { get } }
interfaces.notes: color is computed, never stored.

interfaces.name: Rank
interfaces.signature: enum Rank: Int, Codable, CaseIterable, Hashable, Sendable { case ace = 1, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten, jack, queen, king; var symbol: String { get }; var displayName: String { get } }

interfaces.name: PlayCard
interfaces.signature: struct PlayCard: Identifiable, Codable, Hashable, Equatable, Sendable { let id: Int; let suit: Suit; let rank: Rank; var isFaceUp: Bool }
interfaces.notes: ID is deterministic Int mapping (0..<52), not UUID, to keep undo/invariants stable across restores and fuzz tests.

interfaces.name: DrawMode
interfaces.signature: enum DrawMode: String, Codable, CaseIterable, Sendable { case drawOne, drawThree }

interfaces.name: PileType
interfaces.signature: enum PileType: Hashable, Codable, Sendable { case stock, waste, foundation(Int), tableau(Int) }
interfaces.notes: Addressable pile references for move sourcing and destination checks.

interfaces.name: PileCardList
interfaces.signature: struct PileCardList: Codable, Hashable, Sendable { var cards: [PlayCard] }
interfaces.notes: Ordered pile model used for tableau and stock/waste structures.

interfaces.name: BoardState
interfaces.signature: struct BoardState: Codable, Hashable, Sendable { var stock: [PlayCard]; var waste: [PlayCard]; var foundations: [[PlayCard]]; var tableaus: [[PlayCard]] }
interfaces.notes: Canonical logical board representation persisted in GameSave.

interfaces.name: TerminalState
interfaces.signature: enum TerminalState: Codable, Equatable, Sendable { case active, won(WinSummary), stuck }

interfaces.name: TimerState
interfaces.signature: struct TimerState: Codable, Hashable, Sendable { var startedAt: Date?; var elapsedSeconds: Int; var isRunning: Bool }
interfaces.notes: Logical timer state used for best-time stat and pause semantics.

interfaces.name: MoveAttempt
interfaces.signature: struct MoveAttempt: Codable, Hashable, Sendable { let source: PileType; let sourceIndex: Int?; let destination: PileType; let runCount: Int }
interfaces.notes: Represents tapped-card run selection and destination selection intent.

interfaces.name: MoveOutcome
interfaces.signature: enum MoveOutcome: Equatable, Sendable { case executed(Move); case ambiguous(source: PileID, cardIndex: Int, destinations: [PileID]); case blocked(reason: String) }
interfaces.notes: Single shared result type for the one attemptMove path.

interfaces.name: GameSnapshot
interfaces.signature: struct GameSnapshot: Codable, Hashable, Sendable { let board: BoardState; let timer: TimerState; let drawMode: DrawMode; let moveCount: Int; let selectedSource: MoveAttempt?; let terminalState: TerminalState }
interfaces.notes: Full-state undo snapshot element; never a delta.

interfaces.name: GameState
interfaces.signature: struct GameState: Codable, Equatable, Sendable { var piles: [PileID: [Card]]; var drawMode: DrawMode; var elapsedSeconds: TimeInterval; var isTimerRunning: Bool; var startedAt: Date?; var terminalState: TerminalState }
interfaces.notes: Logical state only — no undo stack, no animation/selection fields.

interfaces.name: GameSaveFile
interfaces.signature: struct GameSaveFile: Codable, Sendable { let schemaVersion: Int; var state: GameState; var undoStack: [GameStateSnapshot] }
interfaces.notes: undoStack capped at 200, LIFO, no redo cursor.

interfaces.name: StatsEvent
interfaces.signature: enum StatsEvent: Codable, Sendable { case gameStarted(sessionId: UUID, drawMode: DrawMode, startedAt: Date); case gameEnded(sessionId: UUID, drawMode: DrawMode, won: Bool, elapsedSeconds: TimeInterval?, undoCount: Int) }
interfaces.notes: gameStarted written immediately at session start so an abandoned/crashed session is still durably recorded as played.

interfaces.name: DrawModeStats
interfaces.signature: struct DrawModeStats: Codable, Equatable, Sendable { var gamesPlayed: Int; var gamesWon: Int; var currentStreak: Int; var bestTimeSeconds: Int?; var lastPlayedAt: Date? }
interfaces.notes: Derived, incrementally-updated cache over StatsEvent, not recomputed on every StatsView render. bestTimeSeconds nil renders as 'N/A'.

interfaces.name: StatsLogFile
interfaces.signature: struct StatsLogFile: Codable, Sendable { let schemaVersion: Int; var drawOne: DrawModeStats; var drawThree: DrawModeStats; var events: [StatsEvent] }

interfaces.name: SettingsState
interfaces.signature: struct SettingsState: Codable, Equatable, Sendable { var drawMode: DrawMode; var cardBack: CardBack; var timerEnabled: Bool; var disclosureAccepted: Bool }
interfaces.notes: Small mutable settings blob.

interfaces.name: SettingsFile
interfaces.signature: struct SettingsFile: Codable, Sendable { let schemaVersion: Int; var drawMode: DrawMode; var cardBack: CardBack; var timerEnabled: Bool }

interfaces.name: PersistenceActorProtocol
interfaces.signature: protocol PersistenceActorProtocol: Actor { associatedtype Model: Codable & Equatable & Sendable; func load() async -> RestoreOutcome<Model>; func save(_ model: Model) async; func markRecovered(reason: PersistenceError) async; func flush() async }
interfaces.notes: Per-file actor contract with independent scheduling and recovery reason tracking.

interfaces.name: FileStorage
interfaces.signature: final class FileStorage: Sendable { init(rootURL: URL); func read<T: Decodable>(_ type: T.Type, from fileURL: URL) async throws -> T; func writeAtomically<T: Encodable>(_ value: T, to fileURL: URL) async throws }
interfaces.notes: Low-level atomic file I/O helper used by all file actors.

interfaces.name: GamePersistenceActor
interfaces.signature: actor GamePersistenceActor: PersistenceActorProtocol { typealias Model = GameSaveFile; init(fileURL: URL, storage: FileStorage); func load() async -> RestoreOutcome<GameSaveFile>; func save(_ model: GameSaveFile) async; func markRecovered(reason: PersistenceError) async; func flush() async }
interfaces.notes: Independent actor for game + undo snapshots only.

interfaces.name: StatsPersistenceActor
interfaces.signature: actor StatsPersistenceActor: PersistenceActorProtocol { typealias Model = StatsLogFile; init(fileURL: URL, storage: FileStorage); func load() async -> RestoreOutcome<StatsLogFile>; func save(_ model: StatsLogFile) async; func markRecovered(reason: PersistenceError) async; func flush() async }
interfaces.notes: Independent actor for event log persistence.

interfaces.name: SettingsPersistenceActor
interfaces.signature: actor SettingsPersistenceActor: PersistenceActorProtocol { typealias Model = SettingsFile; init(fileURL: URL, storage: FileStorage); func load() async -> RestoreOutcome<SettingsFile>; func save(_ model: SettingsFile) async; func markRecovered(reason: PersistenceError) async; func flush() async }
interfaces.notes: Independent actor for settings persistence.

interfaces.name: DeckShuffler
interfaces.signature: protocol DeckShuffler { func shuffle(_ cards: inout [PlayCard], using rng: inout any RandomNumberGenerator) }
interfaces.notes: Testing seam only; production path always uses system RNG.

interfaces.name: GameEngine
interfaces.signature: @MainActor @Observable final class GameEngine { private(set) var state: GameState; private(set) var interaction: InteractionState; init(saveStore: GameSaveStore, statsStore: StatsLogStore, settingsStore: SettingsStore, haptics: HapticsService, integrity: RestoreIntegrityService); func bootstrap() async; func newGame(drawMode: DrawMode, requiresConfirmation: Bool, rng: RandomNumberGenerator = SystemRandomNumberGenerator()); func selectCard(pile: PileID, index: Int); func attemptMove(to destination: PileID) -> MoveOutcome; func drawFromStock(); func undo() -> Bool; func setDrawMode(_ mode: DrawMode); func flushPersistence() async }
interfaces.notes: No @Published (that's Combine/ObservableObject syntax and doesn't compose with @Observable). hasFinishedInitialLoad is NOT here — it lives solely on AppRestoreCoordinator per DEC-design_handoff-006. In-memory mutations (selectCard/attemptMove/drawFromStock/undo) are synchronous; disk writes happen async in the background via the debounced stores.

interfaces.name: RestoreIntegrityService
interfaces.signature: struct RestoreIntegrityService: Sendable { func validate(_ state: GameState) -> ValidationResult }
interfaces.notes: Mandatory semantic gate after successful decode: 52 unique cards, no duplicate/missing ranks-per-suit, legal face-up stacking, foundation monotonicity. A decodable-but-invalid save is data loss, never silently activated.

interfaces.name: SolitaireTabHost
interfaces.signature: struct SolitaireTabHost: View { var body: some View }
interfaces.notes: Root TabView with Game/Stats/Settings peers, gated by AppRestoreCoordinator.hasFinishedInitialLoad.

interfaces.name: DrawModeConfirmSheet
interfaces.signature: struct DrawModeConfirmSheet: View { let targetMode: DrawMode; let onConfirm: () -> Void; let onCancel: () -> Void; var body: some View }
interfaces.notes: Shared by New Game and Settings draw-mode change.

interfaces.name: CardView
interfaces.signature: struct CardView: View { let card: Card; let state: CardVisualState; var body: some View }
interfaces.notes: Single renderer for face-up/face-down/selected/legalDestination/blocked, keyed by card.id.

interfaces.name: Theme
interfaces.signature: enum Theme { enum Fonts {}; enum Spacing {}; enum Radius {}; enum Colors { struct Scene { let background, surfaceBase, surfaceWash, surfaceDepth, vignette, ambientHighlight, pewter: Color }; static let light: Scene; static let dark: Scene }; enum Card { static let frontBase, frontPaper, frontEdge, frontShadow, backBase, backRim, backPattern, inkBlack, inkRed: Color } }
interfaces.notes: Zero literals elsewhere in view layer; card tokens fixed constants with no light/dark variant.

interfaces.name: CardColor
interfaces.signature: enum CardColor: Sendable { case red, black }
interfaces.notes: Paired with a shape-level (non-color) cue in CardView for accessibility.

interfaces.name: Card
interfaces.signature: struct Card: Identifiable, Codable, Equatable, Hashable, Sendable { let suit: Suit; let rank: Rank; var isFaceUp: Bool; var id: String { "\(rank.rawValue)\(suit.rawValue)" } }
interfaces.notes: id is COMPUTED from suit+rank, never stored — single-deck play guarantees uniqueness, id stays stable across isFaceUp toggling (keys matchedGeometryEffect for the flip), and being computed means id is structurally excluded from Codable and can never be persisted wrong.

interfaces.name: PileID
interfaces.signature: enum PileID: Codable, Equatable, Hashable, Sendable { case stock, waste, foundation(Suit), tableau(Int) }
interfaces.notes: foundation keyed by Suit so 'one foundation per suit' is a compile-time fact. tableau(Int) is 0..<7, enforced by GameEngine invariants.

interfaces.name: CardBack
interfaces.signature: enum CardBack: String, Codable, CaseIterable, Sendable { case pewterLattice, vellumSeal }
interfaces.notes: Closed enum so CardBackPicker is exhaustive.

interfaces.name: GameStateSnapshot
interfaces.signature: struct GameStateSnapshot: Codable, Equatable, Sendable { let state: GameState; let capturedAt: Date }
interfaces.notes: Full-state undo entry, no delta encoding.

interfaces.name: Move
interfaces.signature: struct Move: Equatable, Sendable { let cards: [Card]; let source: PileID; let destination: PileID }
interfaces.notes: cards.count > 1 only for a validated tableau-run relocation.

interfaces.name: InteractionState
interfaces.signature: enum InteractionState: Equatable, Sendable { case idle; case sourceSelected(PileID, cardIndex: Int, legalDestinations: [PileID]); case resolvingMove(Move); case dealing; case terminal(TerminalState) }
interfaces.notes: Single explicit FSM for Game-screen interaction; view layer must not maintain parallel @State booleans for selection/highlight.

interfaces.name: WinSummary
interfaces.signature: struct WinSummary: Codable, Equatable, Sendable { let elapsedSeconds: TimeInterval?; let drawMode: DrawMode; let undoCount: Int }
interfaces.notes: elapsedSeconds nil when timer disabled — WinOverlay renders 'N/A', never a fabricated time.

interfaces.name: DealOrchestrator
interfaces.signature: struct DealOrchestrator: Sendable { func dealFresh(into state: GameState, reduceMotion: Bool) -> AnimationPlan; func transit(_ move: Move, reduceMotion: Bool) -> AnimationPlan }
interfaces.notes: Pure/testable planning layer consumed by GameView via matchedGeometryEffect keyed on Card.id. Branches Reduce Motion once per session; drives multi-card run relocation as one coherent transit.

interfaces.name: AnimationPlan
interfaces.signature: struct AnimationPlan: Equatable, Sendable { let steps: [AnimationStep] }

interfaces.name: AnimationStep
interfaces.signature: struct AnimationStep: Equatable, Sendable { let cardID: String; let delay: TimeInterval; let kind: AnimationStepKind }
interfaces.notes: cardID matches Card.id.

interfaces.name: AnimationStepKind
interfaces.signature: enum AnimationStepKind: Equatable, Sendable { case dealArc, flip, slideTransit, reduceMotionFade }

interfaces.name: StatsOutcome
interfaces.signature: enum StatsOutcome: String, Codable, Sendable { case won, abandoned }
interfaces.notes: Per-game terminal outcome for log derivation.

interfaces.name: PersistenceError
interfaces.signature: enum PersistenceError: Error, Sendable { case decodingFailed(description: String); case fileCorrupted; case ioFailed(description: String); case schemaMismatch(found: Int, expected: Int); case semanticallyInvalid(reason: String) }
interfaces.notes: semanticallyInvalid is raised by RestoreIntegrityService after a successful decode.

interfaces.name: RestoreOutcome
interfaces.signature: enum RestoreOutcome<T: Sendable>: Sendable { case restored(T); case fallbackDefault(T, reason: PersistenceError); case dataLoss(reason: PersistenceError) }
interfaces.notes: Returned directly by load(), not thrown — the three-way classification is enforced at the type level.

interfaces.name: GameSaveStore
interfaces.signature: actor GameSaveStore: PersistenceStore { func load() async -> RestoreOutcome<GameSaveFile>; func save(_ model: GameSaveFile) async; func flush() async }
interfaces.notes: load() decodes then runs RestoreIntegrityService.validate before returning .restored. save() debounced ~300-500ms with write-coalescing; flush() forces an immediate write on scenePhase background.

interfaces.name: StatsLogStore
interfaces.signature: actor StatsLogStore: PersistenceStore { func load() async -> RestoreOutcome<StatsLogFile>; func save(_ model: StatsLogFile) async; func append(_ event: StatsEvent) async }
interfaces.notes: append updates events and the relevant DrawModeStats cache, then schedules a debounced save.

interfaces.name: SettingsStore
interfaces.signature: actor SettingsStore: PersistenceStore { func load() async -> RestoreOutcome<SettingsFile>; func save(_ model: SettingsFile) async }

interfaces.name: AtomicFileWriter
interfaces.signature: struct AtomicFileWriter: Sendable { func write<T: Encodable>(_ value: T, to url: URL) throws; func read<T: Decodable>(_ type: T.Type, from url: URL) throws -> T }
interfaces.notes: Temp-write-then-atomic-replace; one shared implementation used by all three stores.

interfaces.name: AppRestoreCoordinator
interfaces.signature: @MainActor final class AppRestoreCoordinator: ObservableObject { @Published private(set) var hasFinishedInitialLoad: Bool; func restoreAll(gameStore: GameSaveStore, statsStore: StatsLogStore, settingsStore: SettingsStore) async }
interfaces.notes: Runs all three loads concurrently via async let; sole owner of the single app-level first-paint gate per DEC-design_handoff-006.

interfaces.name: HapticsService
interfaces.signature: protocol HapticsService: Sendable { func moveAccepted(); func blockedMove(); func stockDraw(); func undo(); func won(); func stuckDetected() }
interfaces.notes: Single call site for all haptics; keeps generators warm via .prepare() on selection.

interfaces.name: CardVisualState
interfaces.signature: enum CardVisualState: Equatable { case normal, selected, legalDestination, blocked }

interfaces.name: GameView
interfaces.signature: struct GameView: View { var body: some View }
interfaces.notes: Reads GameEngine + DealOrchestrator via @Environment; owns no independent selection state.

interfaces.name: WinOverlay
interfaces.signature: struct WinOverlay: View { let summary: WinSummary; let onNewGame: () -> Void; var body: some View }
interfaces.notes: Separate type from StuckOverlay.

interfaces.name: StuckOverlay
interfaces.signature: struct StuckOverlay: View { let onNewGame: () -> Void; let onContinue: () -> Void; var body: some View }

interfaces.name: StatsView
interfaces.signature: struct StatsView: View { var body: some View }

interfaces.name: StatsModeFilter
interfaces.signature: struct StatsModeFilter: View { @Binding var selection: DrawMode; var body: some View }
interfaces.notes: Stats-only, no persistence, no confirmation — structurally distinct from DrawModeSetting.

interfaces.name: EmptyStatePanel
interfaces.signature: struct EmptyStatePanel: View { let drawMode: DrawMode; var body: some View }

interfaces.name: DataLossPanel
interfaces.signature: struct DataLossPanel: View { let onReset: () -> Void; var body: some View }
interfaces.notes: Visually distinct from EmptyStatePanel.

interfaces.name: SettingsView
interfaces.signature: struct SettingsView: View { var body: some View }

interfaces.name: DrawModeSetting
interfaces.signature: struct DrawModeSetting: View { @Binding var mode: DrawMode; let hasActiveGame: Bool; let onRequestChange: (DrawMode) -> Void; var body: some View }
interfaces.notes: Settings-only; always routes through DrawModeConfirmSheet when hasActiveGame.

interfaces.name: CardBackPicker
interfaces.signature: struct CardBackPicker: View { @Binding var selection: CardBack; var body: some View }
interfaces.notes: Applies live, no confirmation.

interfaces.name: RecoveryBanner
interfaces.signature: struct RecoveryBanner: View { let message: String; let onDismiss: () -> Void; var body: some View }
interfaces.notes: Non-blocking, layered after deal settles; also triggered by RestoreIntegrityService failures, not just decode failures.

interfaces.name: ErrorToast
interfaces.signature: struct ErrorToast: View { let message: String; var body: some View }
interfaces.notes: Settings persistence-fallback surface.

interfaces.name: CardGalleryDebugView
interfaces.signature: #if DEBUG struct CardGalleryDebugView: View { var body: some View } #endif
interfaces.notes: Required legibility-gate artifact; renders all 52 CardViews at real cardWidth up through accessibility1.

interfaces.name: cardWidth
interfaces.signature: func cardWidth(contentWidth: CGFloat) -> CGFloat
interfaces.notes: min(56, max(44, (contentWidth - (6*gap + 2*inset)) / 7)).

interfaces.name: StuckDetector
interfaces.signature: protocol StuckDetector: Sendable { func isStuck(_ state: GameState) -> Bool }
interfaces.notes: GameEngine picks the conforming type by state.drawMode.

interfaces.name: DrawOneStuckDetector
interfaces.signature: struct DrawOneStuckDetector: StuckDetector { func isStuck(_ state: GameState) -> Bool }
interfaces.notes: Exact single static legality pass per DEC-detailed_discussion-004.

interfaces.name: DrawThreeStuckDetector
interfaces.signature: struct DrawThreeStuckDetector: StuckDetector { func isStuck(_ state: GameState) -> Bool }
interfaces.notes: Conservative approximation biased against false-positive stuck reports per DEC-app_features-002; fuzz-tested separately from draw-1's exact pass.

interfaces.name: ValidationResult
interfaces.signature: enum ValidationResult: Equatable, Sendable { case valid; case invalid(reason: String) }

interfaces.name: DestinationAccessibilityAction
interfaces.signature: struct DestinationAccessibilityAction: Identifiable, Sendable { let pile: PileID; let label: String; var id: String { label } }
interfaces.notes: Built from InteractionState.sourceSelected's legalDestinations; wired as discrete .accessibilityAction entries per DEC-detailed_discussion-002 whenever a tap resolves to more than one legal destination.

interfaces.name: PersistenceStore
interfaces.signature: protocol PersistenceStore: Actor { associatedtype Model: Codable & Sendable; func load() async -> RestoreOutcome<Model>; func save(_ model: Model) async }
interfaces.notes: Shared contract; each conforming actor owns its own independent serial write queue — never a shared actor across files.
